summary: v43.78 tenant isolation + auto-upgrade backend testing. Created single-class pytest suite (19 tests) covering: country_rules tenant isolation (master/PRO/starter separation), starter plan gate (403 for security_config), master vs bayi rule scoping, DELETE isolation (PRO cannot delete master's RU), slash-aliases master-only CRUD, havale approve auto-upgrade (starter→pro plan + expiry + master_alerts), and marketplace trusted_only filter. All 19 tests PASSED.

minor.issue: Every GET call triggers delete_many({auto_expire_at: {$lt: now, $ne: None}}) — an unindexed write on every read. Consider moving to a background task or indexing auto_expire_at.

When master is impersonating a bayi (impersonated flag), rule ownership falls to the bayi via `owner_license_key or __none__` path; behavior is correct but the `impersonated` branch is only implicit — no explicit unit test coverage in this suite for the impersonated master case.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_country_rules performs delete_many on every GET — potential write amplification / lock contention under load. Move to periodic cleanup job.

tenant.py resolve_tenant_scope: path 3 accepts X-Master-Key header as the bayi key when it starts with 'MS-' and != master_env. This overlaps semantically with the header's original purpose (master auth); works but is easy to misread. Consider renaming to `X-License-Key` or documenting it explicitly.

routes/payments.py havale_approve: license lookup uses case-insensitive email regex `{$regex: ^escaped$, $options: i}` without an index — fine for now but if licenses collection grows, add case-insensitive collation index on email.
havale_approve: subscription_expires_at is overwritten (not extended) on renewal — a paid user upgrading mid-cycle loses remaining days. Consider max(now, current_expiry) + delta.
seed_data_creation: Sets starter license email to starter-bayi-v4378@example.com in setup_class; teardown_class restores plan=starter and cleans test country_rules (CN/RU/DE) and testalias.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test suite uses a single test class TestV4378Isolation with 19 numbered tests (test_01..test_19) so pytest-xdist loadscope keeps everything on ONE worker (avoids DB race conditions between classes). Starter bayi license email is fixture-set to starter-bayi-v4378@example.com. Cleanup restores plan and removes CN/RU/DE country_rules.
rca of the issue: N/A — all features working as specified. During test development, encountered two xdist-related flakes: (1) pytest-xdist loadscope splits classes across workers → cross-class DB races; solved by consolidating into single class. (2) email validator rejects .local TLD; solved by using @example.com. Also observed: get_country_rules delete_many auto-expire logic correctly excludes null auto_expire_at values (verified DB state).
